entities.summary: Maria Oyeyinka Laose is the first female Nigerian Ambassador/Permanent Representative to Austria, Slovakia, UNOV and International Organisations in Vienna. She was appointed in 2011 by H.E President Goodluck Ebele Jonathan and served until mid 2013 upon her retirement from the Nigerian foreign service after 35 meritorious years. She studied French at the University of Ife and received her BA Honours in 1975.
